title: Council approves harbor storm barrier
factSummary: The city council approved funding for a harbor storm barrier on Tuesday.

title: Harbor barrier wins final council vote
factSummary: A Tuesday council vote authorized the same city harbor barrier and its funding.

title: Coastal wind contract awarded
factSummary: The regional authority awarded the North Shoal wind construction contract.

title: Authority selects builder for North Shoal wind project
factSummary: A builder was selected under the regional authority's North Shoal construction award.

title: River line opens to passengers
factSummary: The River light-rail line began passenger service after its opening ceremony.

title: River line extension receives planning vote
factSummary: Two months later the planning board approved a separate extension of the River line.

title: Study maps algae in Lake Alder
factSummary: Researchers published a survey of seasonal algae concentrations in Lake Alder.

title: Lake Alder adopts new boating rules
factSummary: The county adopted boating restrictions for Lake Alder after a public hearing.

title: Falcons win cup final
factSummary: The Harbor Falcons won the national cup final after extra time.

title: Central bank holds policy rate
factSummary: The central bank kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at its April meeting.

title: Mayor says “we won” after certified result
factSummary: Election officials certified the mayoral result and named the winning candidate.

title: Coach says “we won” after semifinal
factSummary: A football coach used the same phrase after the club advanced from a semifinal.
